11.2 / Interaction rules
Keyboard and focus
Visible 3 px focus ring. Focus follows the visual order. Dialogs trap focus and return it when closed. Escape closes transient overlays.
Touch and feedback
Use a 44 px effective target even when the visible control is 32–36 px. Every loading state has a text label. Avoid relying on color alone.
Forms and semantics
Always pair inputs with labels. Keep error messages specific and adjacent. Use aria-expanded for disclosures and clear names for icon-only actions.
Source semantic foregrounds can miss 4.5:1 on their tinted backgrounds. The a11y-* text tokens are deliberate extensions for normal-sized text; original source tokens remain unchanged. Gellix fallback availability and authenticated product behavior remain unverified.
